name: free-adhd-tools
title: Free ADHD cleaning tools: timer, chore breakdown, card maker
description: Three free ADHD cleaning tools that run in your browser: a 5-minute room reset timer, a chore breakdown and a printable task card maker. No signup.

jsonld_extra.name: Free ADHD cleaning tools from Neurotidy

faq.q: Are these ADHD tools really free?
faq.a: Yes. All three run in your browser with no account, no email and no trial. Nothing you type is saved or sent anywhere. They stay free; the only paid thing on the site is an optional printable deck.

faq.q: Which tool should I use first?
faq.a: If you are standing in a messy room, use the room reset timer. If one specific chore keeps getting skipped, use the chore breakdown. If you already know the steps and just keep forgetting them, make a card with the task card maker and tape it where the job happens.

faq.q: Do they work on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. They are plain web pages, so they work in any phone or laptop browser. Keep the tab open while you move around the room.

faq.q: How are these different from an AI task breakdown app?
faq.a: The steps are written by hand from thousands of real ADHD threads, not generated on the spot, so they are the same every time and always include a bad-day version. Nothing goes to a server. If you want a general to-do splitter for any kind of task, an AI tool like goblin.tools Magic ToDo covers more ground; these three are narrower and built only for the home.
